script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.
It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: ‘Nobody just showed up for free’ claims that no other followers joined Abimelech. The text only says he hired some men.
Being the youngest is presented as part of how Jotham survived. The text gives hiding as the reason; it also does not say he got through a particular day.
The explanation repeats that the title is king without adding a useful distinction or any of Papa Dorin’s personality.
‘The text names a throne’ adds a throne that the verse does not mention.
The text says Jotham raised his voice, but it does not say whether anyone could hear him.
The cited passage says Barak summoned the men at Kedesh, not that he gathered them at Mount Tabor.
The explanation states as fact that the olive tree likes its job. Its rhetorical question does not say that.
‘The wrong tree’ uses ‘wrong’ about the baker’s answer.
‘The wrong speaker’ uses ‘wrong’ about the baker’s answer.
‘He puts it plainly because it happened’ supplies a reason for how Jotham speaks that the text does not give.
The last two sentences are generic and add little beyond repeating that Jotham reached Beer.
The text does not say Jotham saw what Abimelech did to his brothers.
